theme_archetype.archetype: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy (Customized for Luxury Editorial Wedding)
theme_archetype.description: Pinterest mood board, romantic and elegant digital invitation. Soft-luxury feel, abundant white space, type-led layouts, minimal decoration.

headings.styles: Elegant, generous line-height, sophisticated scale. Avoid centering everything; use asymmetrical typography blocks where applicable.

devanagari.styles: Use specifically for the Sanskrit Ganesh Shloka to ensure cultural authenticity and legibility.

body.styles: Light and airy, high legibility, clean sans-serif. Used for timeline, addresses, and secondary info.

layout_and_spacing.general: Mobile-first, single-column scroll-based storytelling. Generous vertical spacing (e.g., py-24, py-32). Use negative space as a luxury element to let typography breathe.
layout_and_spacing.containers: Bento grids or masonry for gallery photos (asymmetrical). For family cards, use soft alignments with delicate 1px borders in blush pink or muted gold.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid rgba(232, 211, 209, 0.5) (blush) or rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.3) (muted gold). Rounded corners for photos (e.g., rounded-2xl or rounded-t-full for arched windows).

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Smooth scrolling with Lenis or framer-motion. Staggered fade-up animations on sections.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle scale up (scale-[1.02]) for gallery images, soft brightness shifts for buttons.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Gentle parallax effects on background floral images.

components.audio_toggle: Floating button, bottom right or left. Glassmorphism effect (backdrop-blur). Mute/Unmute icon. Mock Shehnai audio.
components.countdown: Minimalist numbers, thin dividers between DD:HH:MM:SS, elegant labels (Days, Hrs, Mins, Secs).
components.share_button: Prominent floating or footer CTA with WhatsApp icon. Use #25D366 brand color delicately or a luxury styled maroon button with gold text.
components.timeline: Vertical line connecting events, accompanied by lucide-react icons.

images.description: Soft pink and white floral watercolor
Vintage gold texture paper for borders or subtle background accents
Joyful couple in stylish traditional Indian attire

media.icons_library: lucide-react (Icons: Music/AudioLines for shehnai, Utensils for dinner, MoonStar for doli)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first, single-page static site. Use React (JS, not TS) + Tailwind.

Include <link href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@400;500;600&family=Noto+Serif+Devanagari:wght@400;500&family=Marcellus&display=swap' rel='stylesheet'> in your public/index.html or via @import in CSS.
Section 1: Opening Invocation with Sanskrit Ganesh shloka (॥ श्री गणेशाय नमः ।। ...) centered, using Noto Serif Devanagari font.
Section 2: Couple Hero with 'Isha ♥ Himanshu' large text, tagline 'Two souls, one journey', overlay on the hero_background image.
Section 3 & 4: Bride and Groom family cards elegantly laid out side-by-side on desktop, stacked on mobile. Ensure names and parents/grandparents structure match exactly as provided.
Section 5: Event timeline for Sunday, 29th November 2026. Reception of Barat 8PM (icon: AudioLines/Music), Dinner 9PM (icon: Utensils), Doli - Taaron ki Chhaon Mein (icon: MoonStar).

Section 6: Venue card featuring Raj Lakshmi Restaurant & Banquet Hall. Include an embedded Google map (iframe) of Varanasi, UP, and a 'Get Directions' link (href: https://maps.app.goo.gl/BhgxLKMEX8a4J7Fs6).
Section 7: Countdown timer strictly counting down to Nov 29, 2026. Use JS intervals.
Section 8: Photo gallery (4 photos) using a Pinterest-style asymmetrical grid or masonry layout.
Section 9: Closing message ('With love and blessings...').
Section 10: Fixed/floating WhatsApp 'Share Invitation' button (intent: wa.me/?text=...).
Section 11: Fixed/floating Background shehnai audio toggle (Mute/Unmute) using the HTML5 Audio API. Auto-play might be blocked by browsers, so play on first user interaction.
CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements (buttons, links, inputs) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.
